import json, subprocess
from cli_env import subprocess_env
from agent_runner import run_agent_stream

def run(prompt, session_id=None):
    print(f"\n=== prompt={prompt!r} session={session_id} ===")
    sid = session_id
    for t, p in run_agent_stream(prompt, session_id=session_id):
        if t == 'session' and p.get('session_id'):
            sid = p['session_id']
        if t in ('message', 'error', 'done'):
            print(t, json.dumps({k: (v[:100]+'...' if isinstance(v,str) and len(v)>100 else v) for k,v in p.items()}))
    return sid

s1 = run('say hi in 3 words')
s2 = run('what did I just ask?', session_id=s1)
print('\nfinal session', s2)
